perkDefinitions.title: Ignore scenario effects and add one rolling +1 card

perkDefinitions.title: Controlled enemy attacks may use your modifier deck

perkDefinitions.benefit: Optionally control one enemy within Range 5 to perform Attack 1. Both connected boxes are required.
